oidc.title: OIDC Settings
oidc.description: Configure OpenID Connect (OIDC) single sign-on for your workspace.
oidc.connections_description: Each connection can be tied to one verified email domain, which we use to route incoming users to the correct workspace when they start login. Manage multiple clients from here and toggle them on or off without losing their configuration details.
oidc.empty_description: Configure your first OIDC connection to enable single sign-on for your workspace.
oidc.beta_pro_description: OIDC SSO is currently in beta and requires a Pro plan. This feature will soon be part of our Enterprise plan. Upgrade now to start using it.
oidc.beta_pricing_description: OIDC SSO is currently in beta and available on Pro plans. In the coming weeks, when we release our new pricing, this feature will move to our Enterprise plan.
oidc.beta_description: OIDC SSO is still in beta. Test it against your identity provider before rolling it out to your whole workspace.
oidc.upgrade_modal_title: Upgrade to Pro to use OIDC SSO
oidc.upgrade_modal_description: OIDC SSO is a Pro feature. Upgrade your plan to configure single sign-on for your workspace.
oidc.delete_confirm: Are you sure you want to delete "{name}"?

oidc_modal.slug_help: Lowercase, hyphens-only identifier that shows up in the redirect URLs.
oidc_modal.domain_help_with_domain: Must match your email domain ('{domain}' or another subdomain of it).
oidc_modal.domain_help_generic: Must match your email domain (e.g., if your email is user{'@'}company.com, use 'company.com' or another subdomain of it).
oidc_modal.domain_help_providers: Common email providers are not allowed. {support} if you need help.
oidc_modal.redirect_uri_description: Copy this URL and add it to your OIDC provider's allowed redirect URIs:
oidc_modal.issuer_help: Issued by your OIDC provider. Must match the redirect registered in that provider.
oidc_modal.require_state_help: Recommended: validates the state parameter on callback. Disable only if your IdP cannot send state.
oidc_modal.field_mappings_description: Map IdP claim field names to Forms Mentorfy fields. Use this if your IdP uses different field names (e.g., "preferred_username" for email).
oidc_modal.email_field_help: IdP claim name for email (e.g., 'email', 'preferred_username', 'mail'). Leave empty to use default 'email'.
oidc_modal.name_field_help: IdP claim name for full name (e.g., 'name', 'display_name'). Leave empty to use default 'name'.
oidc_modal.role_mapping_description: Map IdP groups to workspace roles. Users will be assigned the highest privilege role from their groups.
oidc_modal.role_mapping_empty: No role mappings configured. Users will be assigned the default "member" role.
